life.failure_message: The sacred thread unravels, life's tapestry frays in chaos and shadow
life.success_message: Life's eternal dance spins flawlessly, from dust to stars, creation thrives!

seasons.failure_message: Seasons stumble, their cycle broken, winter's chill lingers without end.
